data.name: Nida
data.gender_notes: Nida is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ن-د-ي (n-d-y), 'to call'. Nidāʾ means 'a call'. Its root is ن-د-ي (n-d-y). A common Muslim female name. Nida is a Arabic name meaning “Call; voice; announcement”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nida expresses “Call; voice; announcement”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ن-د-ي (n-d-y), 'to call'. Nidāʾ means 'a call'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nida total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
